name: S and Y Industries, Inc.
old_description: Located in Winfield, Kansas, S and Y Industries has been one of America’s premier providers of custom electronics engineering, manufacturing and turnkey assembly services since 1984. As a family-owned, ISO-certified precision manufacturer, we strive to deliver unparalleled production consistency and efficiency with all of our premium electronics solutions.
about:
S and Y Industries, Inc. is based in Winfield, Kansas. The company was founded in 1984 by Sandy Foust on the back porch of a farmhouse in nearby Atlanta, Kansas. It remains a family-owned and woman-owned business, with Foust serving as CEO and her sons Dan and John Foust overseeing production operations and sales.

The firm provides custom electronics engineering, manufacturing, and turnkey assembly services. Its capabilities include printed circuit board (PCB) assembly using surface mount technology (SMT) and thru-hole processes, wire harness assembly, electro-mechanical box-build integration, product test development, and functional testing. Operations run from a 60,000-square-foot facility staffed by more than 100 employees, supporting prototype through low- to mid-volume production runs.

Customers span the medical, aerospace, defense, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company has supplied leading companies in these industries for over 35 years, delivering precision electronic assemblies and complete box-build solutions.

S and Y Industries emphasizes a family-like culture, stating that "people who care about where they work make better products." The leadership describes its approach as acting as a seamless extension of the customer's operation, aiming to provide what the customer wants, when they want it, without unnecessary questions.
